In [[3996 BBY]], A '''battle''' of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], was fought in the [[Manda system/Legends|Manda system]]. The Sith were victorious.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.
